meta.name: alfworld-appliance-preparer
meta.description: Prepares a household appliance (microwave, oven, toaster, fridge) for use by ensuring it is in the correct open/closed state. Use when the agent needs to heat, cool, or cook an item and must first open or close the appliance before placing an object inside. Takes an appliance identifier as input and outputs a confirmation that the appliance is ready for the next action.

copy.tagline: 自动准备家电开关状态，方便后续操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在加热或冷却物品前确保家电已正确开关
copy.tagline_en: Automatically prepare appliance open/close state for next action
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure an appliance is correctly opened or closed before heating or cooling an item

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 会先找到你要用的电器（如微波炉、烤箱），检查它是开还是关，然后根据需要打开或关好，最后告诉你它准备好了。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 加热、冷却或烹饪食物，需要先往电器里放东西的时候就会触发。

say.text: 请准备微波炉1，我要热饭。
say.note: Claude 会导航到微波炉1并打开它。

say.text: 把冰箱2打开，我要放牛奶。
say.note: Claude 会去冰箱2并执行打开动作。
Claude 会检查并关闭烤面包机1。

howto.what_en: Installing this skill makes Claude navigate to the specified appliance, check its open/close state, then open or close it as needed, and confirm readiness.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Claude needs to heat, cool, or cook an item and must first open or close the appliance before placing something inside.

say_en.text: Prepare microwave 1, I want to heat food.
say_en.note: Claude will navigate to microwave 1 and open it.

say_en.text: Open fridge 2, I need to put milk in.
say_en.note: Claude will go to fridge 2 and perform open.
Claude will check and close toaster 1.
